name: Froxel Volume (Frustum Grid)
definition: A view-frustum-aligned 3D texture grid used to store volumetric fog data, replacing axis-aligned world-space grids to optimize for view-dependent rendering.
summary: Froxel Volume is a real-time rendering technique that stores volumetric data in a view-frustum-aligned 3D texture grid to replace per-pixel raymarching, reducing cost by using smaller voxels near the camera.
